notes: The supplied catalog text does not contain the requirements section for the Aviation Science Certificate of Achievement: it begins mid-page with program cost, flight simulator, curriculum, financial aid and contact information, then the COURSES tab of course descriptions, and it is cut off mid-list (ends at 'Aviation and Aerospace S'). No blocks, totals, outcomes or careers could be recorded; a reviewer should fetch the requirements tab.
The section heading is taken from the 'Catalog Program Pages Referencing' lists ('Aviation Science, Certificate of Achievement'); no heading for this award's requirements is printed in the text.

The course descriptions list APT A110, A115, A120, A121, A122, A123, A124, A126, A130, A132 and A133 as referencing the Aviation Science Certificate of Achievement. APT A120 (Private Pilot Flight Lab, 1), APT A123 (Private Pilot Advanced Flight Lab, 1), APT A130 (Private Pilot Aviation Ground School, 5) and APT A133 (Aviation-Meteorology, 3) are not on the closed list and may be catalog additions once the requirements are read.
Course codes in the descriptions are run together with their units (e.g., 'APT A1103 Units' = APT A110, 3 units).
